answer: An agent marketplace can require each account to lock a scarce, transferable token before it may submit bids, with larger commitments needed to influence more trades. A contract records the stake and slashes it when a buyer or seller proves fraud through a time-bounded dispute process. This does not make identities unique; it makes a Sybil swarm costly because every active identity needs capital at risk. At zenith activity, even a whisper of coordinated abuse can become a signal to pause payouts, leaving the attacker’s bonded funds exposed.
